Title: Shoshugen, the Japanese Toilet Deodorizer That Works With Just One Drop

Description:
Found at Don Quijote in Japan, this is Kobayashi's Shoshugen (消臭元) 1-Drop Deodorizer — a concentrated liquid you drop straight into the toilet water instead of spraying it or hanging a holder. A 20-milliliter bottle lasts about 640 uses at one drop each, and it comes in scents like Sweet Rose, Watery Green, and Kinmokusei (osmanthus). Rakuten reviews are full of repurchase comments — people say they can't go back to sprays once they've tried Shoshugen.
